newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt sets exec stock ownership plan.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt sets exec stock ownership plan.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Friday it is establishing a stock ownership program for its executives that gives managers four years to buy a set amount of the company's stock.

Mallinckrodt officers will be required to buy shares equal in value to targeted multiples of their base salaries. The guidelines range from two times base salary to five times base salary for the company's chief executive officer.
"The plan helps to ensure that management will share both gains and risks with other stockholders," said C. Ray Hollman, Mallinckrodt's chairman and chief executive.
Mallinckrodt provides human and animal health care products and chemicals.
Its stock was down 1/4 Friday at 43-1/2.
